description: This Java class 'WorkingDaysRepositoryWrapper' serves as a wrapper around the 'WorkingDaysRepository', adding null checking and error handling, providing methods to find, save, delete, and check working days.

classes.name: WorkingDaysRepositoryWrapper
classes.description: A Spring service class acting as a wrapper around the WorkingDaysRepository, with added null checking and exception handling to manage working days data.

methods.name: WorkingDaysRepositoryWrapper
methods.description: Constructor that injects the WorkingDaysRepository dependency.

methods.name: findOne
methods.description: Fetches the first WorkingDays object; throws WorkingDaysNotFoundException if none are found.

methods.name: saveAndFlush
methods.description: Saves the WorkingDays object and immediately flushes changes to the database.

methods.name: isWorkingDay
methods.description: Checks if a given date is a working day according to the stored WorkingDays object.
